name: fread
expr: fname = tempname; fid = fopen(fname, 'w'); fwrite(fid, [1 2 3 4 5]); fclose(fid); fid = fopen(fname, 'r'); v = fread(fid, 5); fclose(fid); delete(fname); r1 = double(sum(v));
comment: Side-effect smoke test (file I/O round-trip via tempname). fread default-type round-trip -- sum of [1..5] = 15.
